routes.interpretation: Use the global BOS token to initialize, then apply one exact DPLR overwrite per data token and complete the final matrix in the readout.
routes.method: Algebraically identify every overwrite with an RWKV-7 transition and compare compiled long streams with direct products.
routes.control: Removing the BOS initialization loses the first overwrite at N=1.
routes.conclusion: Verified after an explicit BOS indexing repair.

routes.interpretation: Accept the paper's unrestricted rational beta architecture and isolate its layer-4 arithmetic compiler.
routes.method: Reconstruct the three-Householder transvection, eight-step scaled add, and 694-step general 9x9 matrix program.
routes.control: Restricting beta to deployed sigmoid ranges excludes beta=2 and arbitrary 1-lambda.
routes.conclusion: Arithmetic compiler verified; this does not establish the router.

routes.interpretation: Require exact rational arithmetic and the paper's stated two-reflections 2D position cycle.
routes.method: Use the cyclotomic degree obstruction for the required period 1404.
routes.control: Periods 1,2,3,4,6 are the low-degree cases and do not supply 1404 positions.
routes.conclusion: The source router lemma is invalid over Q.

routes.interpretation: Restate the existential theorem over all N and seek an assumption-satisfying counterexample.
routes.method: Evaluate the published zero-state first-token schedule at N=1 and audit the rational DeltaNet router.
routes.control: A separate BOS initialization repairs RWKV, demonstrating why a broken published schedule is not an impossibility theorem.
routes.conclusion: Published constructions are invalid as written; no counterexample rules out every four-layer network, so falsification did not succeed.
